summary: Save JPG copies even when a HEIC-named photo already contains JPEG data.
added: JPEG data in HEIC/HEIF-named files can be saved as verified .jpg copies from the GUI or Explorer menu, without recompression.
changed: Existing JPEG pixels, metadata and orientation are retained. Naming, destination, conflict and timestamp settings still apply.
The queue and compact window explain whether JPEG copies are ready or saved.
fixed: Already-JPEG inputs are ready to process instead of being blocked by a format-mismatch error.
security: Original JPEGs are always retained, even when recycling is enabled for HEIC conversion.
Corrupt and oversized JPEG data is rejected without leaving partial output. Metadata-disabled settings produce an explicit retention warning for unchanged JPEG copies.
notes: Quality and metadata-removal settings apply to HEIC/HEIF conversion; existing JPEGs are copied unchanged.

summary: Clear diagnostics for photos whose contents do not match their filename extension.
added: Input diagnostics identify JPEG, PNG, WebP, GIF, TIFF, PDF, and AVIF data in HEIC/HEIF-named files.
Conversion reports include detected formats, diagnostic codes, short file signatures, and recommended actions.
changed: The main queue and compact Explorer window explain when HEIC-named files are already JPEGs and do not require conversion.
fixed: Rescanning an Explorer selection clears obsolete format diagnostics when the input has changed.
security: Diagnostics leave originals unchanged and do not upload photo data or reports. Exported reports identify their private path/signature contents.
notes: This update diagnoses filename/format mismatches. It does not rename or re-encode mismatched files automatically.

summary: Release-ready desktop experience, support, and GitHub update delivery.
added: About panel with developer details, license information, and manual update checks.
Automatic GitHub update checks with explicit download and restart controls.
In-app problem report form with reviewed email/GitHub drafts and optional basic diagnostics.
Release history, release validation, GitHub issue templates, CI, and tag-based publishing.
Screenshot-based setup and right-click conversion guide.
changed: Professional English copy throughout the application and installer.
One shared brand icon across the interface, taskbar, notifications, installer, and uninstaller.
Installer displays the installation stage and expanded activity details.
Application licensing changes to personal, non-commercial use with unmodified redistribution, subject to third-party rights and earlier grants.
fixed: Closing the main window no longer discards an Explorer selection that is waiting to start.
security: Updater installs are blocked during conversion; automatic checks never trigger unattended installation.
Reports do not collect photos, EXIF, file paths, preferences, or logs automatically.
notes: Windows builds are currently unsigned. Use the official GitHub Releases page.
The new application license applies from 1.2.0; earlier MIT grants remain unaffected.

summary: Compact progress for practical Explorer conversion.
added: Animated compact window with file counts, stages, elapsed time, taskbar progress, and safe Stop.
Version label in advanced settings and a documented installer update procedure.
changed: Explorer selections convert automatically even with the main window open.
Successful compact sessions dismiss after eight seconds; errors stay available for review.
fixed: Repeated selections requeue existing records while honoring conflict settings.
Upgrade installation restores an existing right-click preference.

added: Local HEIC/HEIF decoding and full-resolution JPEG 4:4:4 encoding.
Drag/drop, native dialogs, virtualized queue, search, filters, retries, and safe cancellation.
Metadata and timestamp preservation, configurable outputs, dark/light themes, and keyboard controls.
Opt-in Explorer integration, tray notifications, and Windows installer/uninstaller.
